question: According to the census of India 2011, which of the following states has the highest density of population per square kilometre?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **West Bengal** has the highest population density among Indian states, according to the **2011 Census of India**.
 
• The state’s population density is **1029 people per square kilometer**.
 
• West Bengal is located in the eastern part of India and shares international borders with **Bangladesh, Nepal, and Bhutan**.
 
• The state capital is **Kolkata**, which is also one of the major metropolitan cities in India.
 
• West Bengal is known for its rich cultural heritage and history, being the home of figures such as **Rabindranath Tagore** and **Subhas Chandra Bose**.
 
• The state has a diverse economy that includes agriculture, manufacturing, and services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh**__

 __
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** is the most populous state in India.
 
• The state has a significant historical and cultural heritage, including the city of **Varanasi**, considered one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra**__
 __
 
• **Maharashtra** is the second-most populous state in India and has a diverse economy with a significant presence in industries such as information technology, manufacturing, and finance.
 
• The state capital, **Mumbai**, is the financial capital of India.
 
 
 
• **Odisha**__
 
 
• **Odisha** is located on the eastern coast of India and is known for its ancient temples, such as the **Jagannath Temple** in Puri.
 
• The state has a rich cultural heritage and a significant tribal population.
